London South Bank University courses are designed to prepare students for real-world careers. The university has been established for over 130 years, with a strong tradition of teaching, professional training, and helping individuals develop successful futures.

Now known as London South Bank University (LSBU), it is based in the heart of London. LSBU is recognised for its career-focused education, industry-relevant courses, and commitment to student success. In the 2026 QS World University Rankings, LSBU is ranked #901–950 globally. It also holds a Silver rating in the UK’s Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF).

If you are considering this university, this article will guide you through the London South Bank University Courses. Explore some of the top courses available to help you learn, grow, and progress towards your career goals.

Top Reasons to Choose LSBU for Your Degree

Choosing the right university is an important step towards building your future. London South Bank University Courses are designed around practical learning, industry relevance, and career development. With a central London location, modern facilities, and a diverse student community, LSBU continues to attract students looking for career-focused higher education.

Strong Graduate Employability and Career Focus

LSBU is recognised for its strong focus on employability and preparing students for professional careers. According to the latest Graduate Outcomes and LEO data, LSBU continues to perform strongly in graduate career progression among modern London universities.

Whether you choose Accounting and Finance BA (Hons) with placement, Engineering, Business, Computing, or Healthcare courses, LSBU combines academic learning with practical skills that help students develop industry-ready knowledge.

Recognition for Inclusive and Career-Focused Education

London South Bank University is known for its commitment to widening participation, equality, and student success. The university continues to receive recognition for creating an inclusive learning environment where students from different backgrounds can access high-quality education.

LSBU’s career-focused approach allows students to develop both academic expertise and practical experience throughout their studies.

Industry Connections and Practical Learning Opportunities

Many LSBU courses are developed with professional practice and industry requirements in mind. Students benefit from practical projects, specialist facilities, employer engagement, and opportunities to develop skills relevant to their chosen careers.

Courses such as MSc Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Business, and Healthcare programmes provide students with opportunities to apply their knowledge through real-world learning experiences.

Career Support and Professional Development

LSBU supports students beyond their academic studies through dedicated career services, employability workshops, CV guidance, interview preparation, and professional development activities.

The university’s Careers Hub helps students explore career options, develop workplace skills, and connect with potential employers through various career events and opportunities.

Modern Campuses and Specialist Learning Facilities

LSBU provides modern learning spaces across its campuses, including specialist laboratories, healthcare training facilities, creative studios, and technology-focused environments.

Students studying areas such as Engineering, Nursing, Computing, and Creative Industries benefit from practical facilities designed to support hands-on learning and professional preparation.

Scholarships and Student Support

Students interested in studying in London can also explore suitable accommodation options and student support services available through LSBU.

For students looking for additional scholarship guidance, explore our resources on UK scholarships for international students and London South Bank University Scholarships.

Undergraduate Courses at LSBU: Career-Focused Degrees

At London South Bank University, students can choose from a wide range of undergraduate courses in London across areas such as Business, Engineering, Healthcare, Computing, Law, and Creative Industries.

The idea behind LSBU’s undergraduate education is practical learning. Students do not just study concepts; they also develop skills that connect with real workplace needs. For example, an Engineering student may work with specialist facilities and practical projects that help turn classroom knowledge into professional experience.

If you are exploring different study options in the UK, understanding how courses match your career goals is an important first step. You can also explore our guide on choosing the right university course to compare popular study areas and career-focused options.

Here are some popular undergraduate courses available at LSBU:

Course Duration
BSc Adult Nursing with Foundation Year 4 years
Accounting and Finance BA (Hons) with Placement 3–4 years
Engineering (various fields) 3–4 years
Business Management 3 years
Baking Science and Technology 3 years
Acting for Stage and Screen 3 years
Psychology (BSc) 3 years
Criminology and Forensic Science 3 years

Entry requirements differ depending on the programme and applicant background. Students should review the latest course information before making their final choice.

One thing that often surprises students is the variety of specialised programmes available at LSBU. The Baking Science and Technology degree is a good example. It combines food science, production techniques, and professional bakery skills, which makes it very different from a typical undergraduate pathway.

Postgraduate Programs: Accelerate Your Expertise

LSBU offers a range of postgraduate programs for students who want to build advanced knowledge and strengthen their professional skills. Courses are available across subjects including Business, Engineering, Architecture, Healthcare, Computing, and Social Sciences.

Here’s the thing: postgraduate study is not only about gaining another qualification. The right programme can help students specialise, change career direction, or develop deeper expertise in an existing field.

Some popular postgraduate courses at LSBU include:

LSBU also provides research degree opportunities in areas including Psychology, Sports and Exercise Sciences, Nursing, Health and Social Care, Law, Business, Engineering, Built Environment, and Creative Industries.

Students interested in progressing to advanced academic study can explore research pathways alongside taught postgraduate options. Choosing the right programme usually comes down to three things: previous academic experience, career plans, and the skills you want to develop next.

For students comparing postgraduate opportunities in the UK, our resources on master’s study options and course pathways can help explain different academic routes.

Unique and Specialised Courses You Won’t Find Elsewhere

LSBU offers several specialised programmes that are not commonly available at many other universities in the UK. These courses combine academic learning with practical training, helping students develop skills for specific professional fields.

Here’s the interesting part: some of LSBU’s most distinctive courses come from areas that students may not immediately associate with a traditional university. The National Bakery School is a great example. It shows how higher education can connect specialist industries with academic study.

BSc Baking Science & Technology

The BSc Baking Science & Technology course is delivered through LSBU’s National Bakery School, one of the world’s oldest baking schools, established in 1894. The programme combines baking science, food technology, pastry skills, chocolate production, and food safety.

Students gain practical experience through specialist bakery facilities and laboratory-based learning. The course is especially suitable for students who want to combine creativity with scientific understanding and develop expertise in the food industry.

Advanced Clinical Practice (MSc)

The Advanced Clinical Practice MSc is designed for healthcare professionals who want to develop advanced clinical knowledge and professional skills.

The course focuses on areas such as clinical decision-making, research skills, and advanced practice. Students build on their existing healthcare experience while developing expertise that supports progression within healthcare careers.

Digital Architecture & Robotic Construction (MSc)

Digital Architecture & Robotic Construction is one of LSBU’s technology-focused postgraduate programmes. The course explores how digital tools, automation, robotics, and modern construction methods are changing the future of building design.

Students learn how technology can improve the way buildings are designed and created. Practical learning through specialist facilities helps connect digital concepts with real construction challenges.

Allied Health Diplomas

LSBU also offers professional diploma pathways in healthcare-related areas, including subjects such as physiotherapy, occupational therapy, and radiography.

These programmes focus on practical knowledge and professional development, helping students build skills for healthcare environments.

Students interested in exploring specialist study options can also learn more about different healthcare and professional pathways through our resources on healthcare-related university courses.

Application Process and Entry Requirements

Choosing the right London South Bank University Courses is only the first step. A successful application also depends on selecting the right programme, understanding requirements, and preparing accurate supporting documents.

The process may seem straightforward. But here’s the thing: many students focus only on choosing a course and forget that preparation plays an equally important role.

Entry Requirements for International Students

LSBU entry requirements vary depending on the chosen programme, previous qualifications, and the applicant’s academic background. Different subjects may have different expectations, so students should always review the latest course information before applying.

Academic Requirements

For undergraduate courses, applicants usually need a recognised secondary qualification that meets UK higher education standards. Accepted qualifications can vary depending on the student’s country and education system.

For postgraduate programmes, applicants generally need a recognised bachelor’s degree or an equivalent qualification. Some courses may also consider relevant professional experience or subject-specific backgrounds.

English Language Requirements

Most courses require students to demonstrate their English language ability through an accepted qualification. The required level depends on the programme and the applicant’s circumstances.

LSBU may accept recognised English language tests, including IELTS, TOEFL iBT, and Pearson PTE. Students comparing different test options can explore our guide on English proficiency tests accepted by universities.

Application Process for International Students

Applying to LSBU usually involves a few key stages:

  1. Explore available courses and choose a programme that matches your academic background and career goals.
  2. Prepare your academic documents and supporting information.
  3. Submit your application through the appropriate platform. Undergraduate applicants can apply through UCAS.
  4. Provide required documents such as academic records, English language results, personal statements, and references where applicable.
  5. Review the university response and complete any further steps requested by LSBU.

Students who are planning their UK university journey can also explore our guide on how university applications work for additional guidance.

Student Life and Campus Facilities

Studying at London South Bank University is about more than attending lectures. Students become part of a diverse London community where academic learning, personal development, and social experiences come together.

London itself becomes part of the learning experience. A business student can attend industry events across the city, while a creative student can explore museums, exhibitions, and professional networks nearby.

Campus and Facilities

LSBU provides learning environments designed around different areas of study. Students have access to specialist facilities including laboratories, healthcare training spaces, creative studios, libraries, and collaborative study areas.

A Nursing student, for example, needs more than classroom theory. Practical training environments help develop confidence before entering professional settings.

Accommodation and Living

Finding suitable accommodation is an important part of preparing for university life in London. Students usually consider factors such as location, travel time, facilities, and budget when choosing where to live.

For students comparing different areas and living arrangements, our guide on student living options in London provides useful information.

Clubs, Societies, and Student Union

University life becomes more enjoyable when students connect with others. LSBU supports a range of student activities, societies, and communities where students can meet people with similar interests.

Whether someone enjoys sports, technology, arts, or cultural activities, these groups create opportunities to build friendships outside the classroom.

Student Support and Wellbeing

LSBU provides different support services to help students manage university life successfully. Students can access academic guidance, wellbeing support, disability services, and personal assistance when needed.

A small but important detail: students often discover the value of these services after they arrive. Having support available from the beginning can make adapting to a new environment much easier.

Careers and Enterprise

Career preparation starts before graduation at LSBU. Students can access guidance related to employability skills, professional development, CV preparation, and career planning.

The university also supports students interested in entrepreneurship by helping them explore ideas, develop skills, and understand business opportunities.

Diversity and Community

LSBU welcomes students from different countries, cultures, and backgrounds. This creates a learning environment where students gain perspectives beyond their own experiences.

For many students, meeting people from different parts of the world becomes one of the most memorable parts of studying in London.

Career Outcomes and Industry Links

LSBU focuses on connecting education with professional development. Many programmes include practical projects, industry engagement, and opportunities that help students understand how their knowledge applies in real workplaces.

Strong Employability

Career-focused learning is one of LSBU’s main strengths. Students across subjects such as Engineering, Business, Healthcare, and Computing develop both academic knowledge and practical abilities.

The surprising part is that employability is not only about getting a job after graduation. It starts with building confidence, communication skills, and professional awareness during university.

Industry Partnerships

LSBU works with professional organisations and employers to ensure courses remain connected with industry needs.

Students can benefit from employer events, practical projects, and industry-focused learning opportunities across areas such as healthcare, engineering, business, and technology.

Career Support

The LSBU Careers Hub helps students prepare for professional life through workshops, career guidance, and skills development activities.

Support may include improving CVs, preparing for interviews, understanding career options, and connecting with professional opportunities.

Students who want to explore career-focused study options can also read our guide on courses linked with future career demand.

Enterprise Opportunities

Some students want a traditional career path. Others want to build something of their own.

LSBU Enterprise supports students who are interested in innovation, entrepreneurship, and developing business ideas. With the right guidance, a small university project can become the foundation for a future opportunity.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the most popular courses at LSBU?

Popular London South Bank University courses include Nursing, Business Management, Engineering, Computing, Law, Data Science, and Creative Industries programmes. The right choice depends on your academic background, interests, and future career goals.

Does LSBU offer foundation year programmes?

Yes, LSBU offers foundation year programmes for selected undergraduate courses. These programmes help students strengthen their academic skills and prepare for degree-level study.

What is the acceptance rate at LSBU?

LSBU does not publish an official acceptance rate. Admission decisions depend on factors such as the chosen course, academic qualifications, and whether applicants meet the programme requirements.

Are part-time postgraduate courses available at LSBU?

Yes, LSBU offers flexible study options for selected postgraduate programmes. Availability depends on the specific course, so students should check the latest programme details before applying.

What scholarships are available at LSBU?

LSBU provides different scholarship opportunities and academic awards for eligible students. These may include merit-based awards, international scholarships, and course-related support options.

Students should review the latest scholarship information because eligibility and availability can change each academic year.

How much are tuition fees at LSBU?

Tuition fees vary depending on the course, study level, and student category. Since university fees can change annually, students should check the latest information for their chosen programme.

Does LSBU provide accommodation options?

Yes, LSBU provides accommodation information and support to help students explore suitable living arrangements during their studies in London.

When choosing accommodation, students should consider location, transport links, facilities, and personal preferences.

Which LSBU courses include placement opportunities?

Many LSBU courses include practical learning opportunities, industry projects, and professional development activities. Placement availability depends on the individual programme, with opportunities across areas such as Engineering, Business, Healthcare, and Computing.

Is LSBU good for Nursing courses?

LSBU is recognised for its healthcare education and practical approach to learning. Nursing students benefit from specialist training environments and opportunities to develop professional skills for healthcare careers.

Conclusion

London South Bank University courses are designed for students who want more than academic knowledge. With practical learning, industry-focused teaching, specialist facilities, and a diverse student community, LSBU helps students develop skills that connect with real career opportunities.

From undergraduate degrees to postgraduate programmes, LSBU offers study options across areas including Engineering, Business, Healthcare, Computing, Law, Architecture, and Creative Industries. The university’s central London location also gives students access to a global city filled with professional, cultural, and networking opportunities.

Choosing the right university depends on your goals, interests, and future plans. If you are exploring LSBU courses and want guidance on finding the right study pathway, you can speak with our education advisors for personalised support.

Your next step towards studying at London South Bank University can start with the right information and a clear plan.
